service_boundary: Represents DeepInfra-hosted APIs and deployments, not model publishers, client libraries, or customer-operated copies of the same weights.
regional_controls: The reviewed serverless documentation does not establish customer-selected regions for every model; dedicated deployment placement requires plan-specific review.
retention_controls: Data handling follows DeepInfra's terms and privacy documentation; dedicated and serverless logging behavior should be verified separately.
routing: Customers select a DeepInfra-hosted model or endpoint rather than upstream inference providers.
customization: Dedicated deployments and custom model hosting are available for supported artifacts.
strengths: A broad open-model catalog is available through compatible and task-specific APIs.
Serverless and dedicated paths address different capacity needs.
tradeoffs: Catalog lifecycle follows upstream model availability.
Enterprise regional and retention controls require plan-specific confirmation.
